recruiterCard.summary: Worked across QA, automation, and regulated-release validation to improve regression coverage, release confidence, and documentation readiness in a compliance-sensitive environment.
impactBullets: Built Selenium and C# automated test suites, increasing regression coverage by 40% across web and API layers.
Integrated automated tests into GitHub Actions CI pipelines to prevent regressions and accelerate deployments.
Logged and triaged 50+ defects with engineers, improving release stability and reducing post-deploy incidents.
Authored SOP-aligned validation documentation supporting 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and audit readiness.
